subject: Evaluation exit criteria, MAP milestones and commitment window
messages:
From: Samantha Park <samantha@orbital.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: MAP update + request to lock commitment window

Hi team,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the MAP looks good and the evaluation is progressing on our end. Quick context and asks:

- Outcomes so far: inference latency tests at our 2k token tail are within target on the dedicated pool; qualitative evals passed the 15 prompt set with one prompt flagged for hallucination risk.
- Procurement is asking for a firm start-week and confirmation of the SOW redline status so they can prepare internal budget sign-off.
- Legal has one remaining ask on the data retention clause (we flagged a requested 13 months).

Can we lock a 72-hour window for signatures (we're proposing Mon 13 Dec 09:00–12:00 PT) and confirm who at Redwood needs exec approval for any term >3 months? Also attaching our latest MAP spreadsheet with the evaluation checkpoints.

Attachments: MAP_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks,
Samantha Park
Head of Platform Partnerships
Orbital.ai

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Park <samantha@orbital.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP update + request to lock commitment window

Samantha — thanks for the update and for the MAP spreadsheet. Short answers up front: we can support the proposed 72-hour signature window (Mon 13 Dec 09:00–12:00 PT) provided legal and finance clear the SOW redlines by Thu EOD the week prior.

Operational notes and asks from our side:
- Evaluation exit criteria: we need the agreed pass/fail thresholds in writing for the hallucination prompt and the latency SLA for 95th percentile at target tokens. Please confirm whether you want the current 15-prompt set to be the canonical eval or whether you'll add the three recent prompts you mentioned.
- Approval chain: internal signers will be (1) Sales Director (Kimberly Park) for commercial, (2) Legal counsel (Irene Choi) for contract, and (3) Head of Product (Aditya Rao) only if we accept the 13-month retention request. If retention remains at the standard 6 months, Aditya is not required.
- If legal redlines are not cleared by Thu 10 Dec 18:00 PT, we will move the signature window to Tues 14 Dec same time. We should decide today so procurement can freeze the budget.

I'll pull the latest SOW with our redlines and send to legal for triage. Kimberly — can you confirm you can be on the 13th morning slot? Irene — any quick flags on the 13-month retention?

Regards,
Mateo Alvarez
Sr. Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Samantha Park <samantha@orbital.ai>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP update + request to lock commitment window

Matt/Team — I can cover the commercial signature on 13 Dec 09:00–12:00 PT. A couple of clarifications from procurement/commercial:

- Pricing: the committed unit rate in the SOW matches the quote sent 11/22. If legal toggles any usage or retention terms that change price, we need a pricing concurrence before the signature window opens.
- Escrow/rollback: we should include a 14-day rollback clause post-start for the pilot. It's standard for larger POCs and helps procurement get internal signoff.

Samantha — can you confirm the canonical eval prompt set and whether you intend to expand it? If you add prompts after Thu we will require a 48-hour re-run before final acceptance.

Kimberly Park
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Samantha Park <samantha@orbital.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP update + request to lock commitment window

Samantha — quick legal triage below:

- Data retention: Orbital's ask for 13 months is a material change from our standard 6 months. We'll need Product sign-off (Aditya) because this impacts caching and customer data lifecycle on the runtime. If Aditya approves, Legal will accept with a compensating data minimization clause.
- SLAs and remedies: redlines are minor; we can keep our standard 99.5% uptime and a token-based rebate structure.
- Signatures: our internal legal counsel can be available for the 13 Dec window but we need the redline PDF in final form by Thu 10 Dec 17:00 PT.

I've started the redline pass on the SOW and will attach the doc once done.

Irene Choi
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Park <samantha@orbital.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 04 Dec 2026 15:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP update + request to lock commitment window — decision and next steps

Thanks all — summary and firm plan below (ACTION ITEMS in bold).

Summary decisions:
- Signature window: LOCKED for Mon 13 Dec 09:00–12:00 PT (virtual DocuSign session + 15-minute buffer per signer).
- Approval chain: Kimberly (Commercial), Irene (Legal) and Aditya (Product) only if we accept 13-month retention.
- Evaluation set: Orbital to confirm canonical 15 prompts by Thu 10 Dec 12:00 PT. Any prompts added after that require a 48-hour re-run before acceptance.

Action items:
- Samantha/Orbital: PLEASE SHARE final canonical prompt set by Thu 10 Dec 12:00 PT and attach eval-sample-prompts.txt to the HubSpot record. (related link: https://hubspot.company/contacts/ORB-2026-0421) **(OWNER: Samantha)**
- Redwood Legal (Irene): COMPLETE redline pass on SOW and upload SOW_redlines_v1.pdf by Thu 10 Dec 17:00 PT. **(OWNER: Irene)**
- Kimberly: CONFIRM commercial pricing will not change with the retention decision by Thu 10 Dec 18:00 PT. **(OWNER: Kimberly)**
- Aditya: REVIEW product impact of 13-month retention by Thu 10 Dec 18:00 PT and CONFIRM whether Product approval is required. **(OWNER: Aditya)**
- Mateo: I'll coordinate the DocuSign queue and send stakeholders the esign links on Fri 11 Dec EOD assuming the above are complete. **(OWNER: Mateo)**

Contingency: if legal redlines or pricing change after Thu 10 Dec 18:00 PT, we will shift the window to Tue 14 Dec 09:00–12:00 PT and notify procurement immediately.

Attachments queued for upload: MAP_v3.xlsx, SOW_redlines_v1.pdf (when ready), eval-sample-prompts.txt

Cheers,
Mateo Alvarez
Sr. Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
